paragraphs: Green Media Events is a named Philippine race organiser whose Takbo Para sa Kalikasan series focuses on environmental themes. Previous editions have incorporated eco-friendly race-kit materials, tree-planting initiatives tied to finisher numbers, and partnerships with environmental NGOs. The advocacy character distinguishes this race from the growing number of commercially-driven fun runs in Metro Manila [1].
sections.heading: Green Media Events: Advocacy Through Running

paragraphs: The course runs through Ermita, one of Manila historic districts, with routes likely extending along Roxas Boulevard and the Manila Bay waterfront. The terrain is flat, and the early-morning September start provides partial relief from Manila daytime heat. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) cover the running spectrum [1].
sections.heading: The Course: Ermita and Manila Bay

paragraphs: September is the tail of the Philippine wet season: temperatures of 26-32C with humidity above 80 percent. Rain is a live possibility for a 20 September race, though September rainfall in Manila is typically lower than July and August. The Ermita location provides some shelter options at Rizal Park and surrounding buildings. Pack quick-drying kit and a waterproof phone pouch [3].

paragraphs: Registration has not yet been announced for the 2026 edition. Runners should monitor Pinoy Fitness and Green Media Events social channels for the registration opening. Ermita is central Manila, served by LRT-1 (United Nations Avenue station) and accessible by taxi or Grab from anywhere in Metro Manila. Parking in Ermita is limited; public transport or Grab is recommended [1].
